Proposition
[Stability of uncrumpled realizations] 1. 9.5.7\group thurston.ch09.interpolationSource: thurston:page-0265Source: thurston:page-0266 If an essentially complete lamination $\gamma $ is realized by $U$, then every uncrumpled surface realizing a lamination sufficiently close to $\gamma $ is close to $U$.
